fusions.name: Rap on the Knuckles
fusions.desc: A strike with the rod that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Parade Drill
fusions.desc: Drills every ally within 5 tiles: each strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Under Instruction
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. The effect grows 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
